scope.opera_memory_policy: one source tab plus one target tab; tab IDs reused

source_material.method: direct source stylesheet inspection plus same-Opera source/target screenshots

proven_visual_deltas.source_observed: bronze-leaf eyebrow; two equal large rounded cards; beige negative card, sage positive card; warning/growth header icons; X/check leaf bullets; source spacing and typography
proven_visual_deltas.target_observed: eyebrow styling missing; generic white cards; default browser bullets; uneven card heights/visual weight
proven_visual_deltas.cause: content is source-equivalent but target uses af-sub-* markup that does not receive the source compare/checklist rules
proven_visual_deltas.fix_strategy: map exact source geometry/colors/list semantics onto existing page264 markup; no content or DOM rewrite

proven_visual_deltas.source_observed: centered eyebrow/title/intro; one white rounded panel; 18x18 clock icon in reply pill; compact contact buttons; form fields begin inside same panel
proven_visual_deltas.target_observed: heading block left aligned; reply SVG expands to a huge arc; intro and MetForm do not visually join into source form panel
proven_visual_deltas.cause: source markup is split into two Elementor siblings and several source form component rules are absent/not winning on page264
proven_visual_deltas.fix_strategy: join the two existing widgets visually using scoped background/border/radius/padding; constrain existing reply SVG to 18x18; restore source contact component rules; no form field/value/submission change

deployment_contract: Re-read page264 _elementor_data hash and JSON validity immediately before write.
Re-read current Additional CSS post8 length/hash and prove project end marker is present and the oldtrees marker absent or reconcile drift.

Use the supported server-side content/search + match-once content/edit path against post8; preserve all existing Additional CSS bytes and insert only the complete marked page264 block before the unique af-project:end marker.
Do not write any other page/template/media/plugin setting. Do not alter global header/footer CSS.
Read back Additional CSS hash/marker and page264 Elementor hash after write.
Fresh-load source/target comparison and form anchors using only one Opera pair and capture diagnostic screenshots; iterate only if a measured visual cause remains.
Do not purge cache unless fresh rendered page is demonstrably stale after the supported CSS save.

blockers.wpvibe: A content/search request for the Additional CSS end marker returned HTTP 429 after the read-only hash preflight; no CSS write was attempted.
blockers.controlled_viewports: Opera connector exposes screenshot but not deterministic viewport/DPR/zoom controls.
blockers.acceptance_json: specs/acceptance.json and specs/behaviors.json are absent from repository history; do not invent them.
